_template_notes.purpose: RBAC matrix — Discovery #6. Actors × Actions × Resources permission matrix. EUREKA có 90+ RBAC permissions. Source: Permission constants + [Authorize] attributes + role assignment configs.
populate: actors[]: roles + role groups — {id, name (vd SalesManager, FinanceAccountant, MobileCustomer), description, hierarchy_parent?}
actions[]: CRUD + business actions — {id, name (vd CreateCustomer, ApproveInvoice), verb, scope=global|module|tenant|owner}
resources[]: protected resources — {id, name (vd Customer, Invoice, Shipment), module, ownership_field?}
permissions[]: actor × action × resource matrix — {actor_id, action_id, resource_id, grant=allow|deny, conditions[]}
gaps[]: resources không có permission cho actor cần access — {actor_id, resource_id, missing_actions[]}
metadata.over_permissioned: actor có quá nhiều permissions (security risk)
metadata.under_permissioned: workflow break vì actor thiếu permission
